name: Cursor
description: AI-native code editor with Agent, project Rules, AGENTS.md, Skills, and MCP integrations for repository-aware development.
bestFor: Bounded feature implementation in an existing repo
Iterating with rules/skills that match team conventions
notIdealFor: Unattended production changes without human review
Tasks that need verified domain research the model cannot access
Bulk refactors without tests and diff review
costModelSummary: Editor subscription tiers; model usage may incur separate provider costs depending on plan/settings.
securityNotes: Do not paste secrets into prompts
Enable MCP servers with least privilege only
Treat agent-claimed test results as unverified until you run them
